title: No generator models/adapters: no catalog model outputs media; image/video/audio generation impossible
body: BI-0188: register generators + provider adapters, expose to modality layer, license-gated.

rcca.root_cause: The model catalog covered chat/vision only and had no generator transport; provider shaping was chat-shaped and no generator registry or adapter contract existed.
rcca.corrective: core/generator_adapters.py (catalog + uniform submit/status/fetch/cancel/cost contract + async job store + budget/ledger, fail-closed); config/generators.json with license/open_weights/free gating; modality.models_for_output unions the generator registry; provider_kinds features extended; CLI generate.
rcca.preventive: Generators carry license/open_weights/free and are only offered when permitted; no key/no candidate => structured no_generator_available (never fabricated); self-host usable with no key.
rcca.fixed_where: core/generator_adapters.py; config/generators.json; core/modality.py; core/provider_kinds.py; scripts/pipeline.py; config/store-registry.json; test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_generator_adapters.py
